newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CLOSING SHARE MARKET REPORT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CLOSING SHARE MARKET REPORT.

text.p: Dutch shares closed slightly lower after a mixed session. The AEX share index touched an intra-day high, but the gain did not hold.
The AEX share index ended at 860.86, down 1.34 points, after touching a high of 864.63 earlier.
Dealers said the market was closely watching Wall Street, which opened lower, but most expected the dip was temporary.
Some investors took profits and post and telecoms group KPN fell 1.40 guilders to 80.90, but the stock is seen holding above resistance levels. "A drop below 80.00 is not likely," said one dealer.
Consumer products group Unilever hit a new record in early trade, but gains faded somewhat when the dollar edged lower.
Unilever ended 1.20 guilders higher at 410.00, after touching an all-time high of 413.00 guilders.
Insurer Aegon rose 1.70 guilders to 139.80, but other financials were off as ABN AMRO , ING and Fortis Amev lacked any positive impetus from bonds.

Publisher Elsevier topped the volume list after announcing a big acquisition in the U.S. Dealers said the acquisition of Chilton Business was positive but the news failed to prevent Elsevier shares falling 0.50 guilders to 32.20.
The winners of the day were found in the high-tech sector.
Semiconductor maker ASM Lithography jumped 7.40 guilders to 115.00. Software company Baan added 4.50 guilders to 129.50, after touching a record of 132.00.
"The demand for high-tech stocks is strong and will probably continue as U.S. investors keep buying into the sector," said one dealer, adding he saw scope for further rises.
Chemicals firm Akzo Nobel ended lower, a fall one dealer attributed to a big UK-based seller in the market.
Akzo Nobel dropped 3.80 guilders to 257.20, off an earlier low of 256.00 guilders.
